# Meelte

> Meelte is a hyperlocal community platform for India. It shows time-boxed offers from nearby shops, local events you can request to join, and one-to-one chat with the people and businesses you meet around you — without selling or sharing user location.

Meelte is available as an Android app on Google Play. The web app is in development and is not live. The app sorts everything by distance from the user, with a "Max distance" filter that defaults to 60 km. Meelte does not sell goods, run events, take payments or broker transactions: purchases are settled directly with the shop, and any event cost is settled directly with the host.

- Official Website: https://meelte.com
- Contact: support@meelte.com
- Phone: +91-8884524444
- Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada
- Coverage: India — operational hubs in Bengaluru, Gaya and Ranchi
- Android package: com.meelte.classico

## What The App Does

- [Local offers](https://meelte.com/discover#offers): Shops post a single product or a catalogue of up to 100 items with a price or discount and a fixed run of dates. Viewers can like, comment, share, get one-tap Google Maps directions, and follow the shop.
- [Local events](https://meelte.com/discover#events): Residents, clubs and organisers publish events with a date, time, pinned location and joining cost. Attendees request to join with their group size, and the host approves, rejects or removes people.
- [People & chat](https://meelte.com/discover#people): Friends, follows, one-to-one chat with text, emoji, documents and location sharing, plus audio and video calls. Finding new people is still rolling out.

## What Meelte Does Not Do

- Meelte does not sell goods, run events, take payments or broker transactions. There is no in-app payment, ticketing or escrow.
- Meelte does not operate a jobs board.
- Meelte does not verify the identity of individual users. Shops are signed up in person by Meelte's field team.
- Merchant pricing is not published.
